The same habit that shapes our games, looking at a problem twice before solving it, goes into our software. Our first software projects are in development and will be announced here.

Double Perspective is an independent studio making games and software. The name is how we work: every problem can be seen from more than one angle, and the best answer usually comes from looking at it twice.
Umbral Purge, Amber & Sage Sudoku, and Amber & Sage Solitaire are our first releases: a dark adventure, a quiet puzzle and a peaceful hand of cards. More games and software will follow.

Umbral Purge is a dark fantasy survivor roguelite built around constant pressure and meaningful choices. Your weapons fight automatically while you dodge danger, collect experience, and shape your build through upgrades and evolutions.
Travel through five distinct regions. Each brings its own enemies and environmental dangers.
Open ground and the first relentless hordes. Learn to move, collect experience, and build your arsenal.
Cacti and sand strikes turn the battlefield into a test of positioning.
Slippery movement and falling icicles make every step matter.
Lava and eruptions threaten even the strongest builds.
Deeper darkness and overlapping dangers push survival to the limit.
Each class brings a different approach to combat. Unlock new heroes as you progress.
The starting survivor. Adaptable and well suited to learning the fight.
Commands spirits that fight alongside you.
Wields a scythe and stands firm against incoming damage.
Spreads poisonous danger across the battlefield.
Channels magical orbs to pursue enemies.
Fights at range with piercing arrows and precise strikes.
Combine upgrades to unlock more powerful attacks.
Earn Embers and invest in Armory upgrades between runs.
Take on new goals and test different builds.
Survive powerful foes and fight for valuable rewards.
